topic: LeBron James showing fan-friendly moments versus reacting negatively when unexpectedly touched by a fan in Paris.

script: This is why you don't touch LeBron James. Even though LeBron usually shows love to his fans, there's one thing that instantly changes his mood. For more than 20 years, he's been great with fans who cheer for him and show respect. But once someone touches him, that friendly LeBron disappears real quick. Just ask this kid in Paris: LeBron, is it possible to take a picture please? Stop. Don't do that.
what_makes_it_work: Strong hook with immediate visual contrast of LeBron's mood change
Fast-paced montage establishing his usual friendly persona before the dramatic payoff
Real, raw footage of the Paris interaction delivering on the hook's premise
